messages.subject: Project Willow - consensual restructuring proposal
messages.plaintextBody:
Gareth, Fiona,

Please find attached the Company's consensual restructuring proposal, prepared with Marlow. Headlines: £4.0m new shareholder equity, £2.0m TLA prepayment (reducing TLA to £12.0m), a new £3.0m super-senior WC facility, covenant reset stepping to 3.50x, +150bps margin to 5.25% and a £150k amendment fee. Sources and uses tie at £4.0m.

We'd welcome the Bank's feedback so we can move to documentation and sign by 22 May.

James Osei
Senior Associate, Restructuring & Finance
Whitfield Carter LLP
Confidential and may be legally privileged.

messages.subject: RE: Project Willow - consensual restructuring proposal
messages.plaintextBody:
James,

Thank you - credit are supportive in principle. Likely pushback on margin (we'll be looking nearer 5.75%) and the opening leverage level, and we'll want the amendment fee revisited. Pendle Voss will revert on the documentation. Gareth

Gareth Sully
Director, Restructuring & Recoveries | Pennine Business Bank plc
